import duckdb
import ggsql
from shiny import App, ui
from shinywidgets import output_widget, render_altair


# The bundled CSV must remain alongside this app file.
CSV_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("mtcars.csv")
if not CSV_PATH.exists():
    raise FileNotFoundError(
        f"Could not find {CSV_PATH.name}. Place it in the same directory as this app."
    )

con = duckdb.connect()
con.execute(
    "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE mtcars AS "
    "SELECT * FROM read_csv_auto(?)",
    [str(CSV_PATH)],
)

SQL_QUERY = """
SELECT
  CAST(cyl AS VARCHAR) AS cylinders,
  AVG(mpg) AS avg_mpg
FROM mtcars
GROUP BY cyl
ORDER BY avg_mpg DESC
"""

VISUALISE_CLAUSE = """
VISUALISE cylinders AS y, avg_mpg AS x
DRAW bar
PROJECT y, x TO cartesian
LABEL x => 'Average fuel economy (mpg)', y => 'Cylinders'
"""

mpg_by_cylinder = con.execute(SQL_QUERY).df()
chart = ggsql.render_altair(mpg_by_cylinder, VISUALISE_CLAUSE)

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.tags.style(
        """
        body { background: #f7f9fc; }
        .dashboard { max-width: 900px; margin: 2.5rem auto; }
        .dashboard-title { margin-bottom: 0.35rem; color: #17233b; }
        .dashboard-subtitle { color: #596579; margin-bottom: 1.75rem; }
        .caption { color: #596579; margin: 1rem 0 0; }
        """
    ),
    ui.div(
        {"class": "dashboard"},
        ui.h1("Fuel Economy by Engine Size", class_="dashboard-title"),
        ui.p(
            "Average MPG across the mtcars vehicle dataset.",
            class_="dashboard-subtitle",
        ),
        ui.card(
            ui.card_header("Average MPG by Cylinder Count"),
            output_widget("mpg_by_cylinder_chart"),
            ui.p(
                "Fuel economy can be compared across engine cylinder groups; "
                "higher bars indicate higher average miles per gallon.",
                class_="caption",
            ),
        ),
    ),
)


def server(input, output, session):
    @render_altair
    def mpg_by_cylinder_chart():
        return chart


app = App(app_ui, server)

SELECT
  CAST(cyl AS VARCHAR) AS cylinders,
  AVG(mpg) AS avg_mpg
FROM mtcars
GROUP BY cyl
ORDER BY avg_mpg DESC
VISUALISE cylinders AS y, avg_mpg AS x
DRAW bar
PROJECT y, x TO cartesian
LABEL x => 'Average fuel economy (mpg)', y => 'Cylinders'
